# Beam 1.0 launch — Tue Oct 6

Open-source 1.0 of Beam (MIT), plus the hosted team workspace waitlist.

## Checklist
- [x] Trace format v1 frozen (Daniel)
- [x] Onboarding redesign phase 1 (Hannah, Sofia)
- [ ] Docs site + quickstart (Sofia) — due Oct 2
- [ ] Launch video, shot by [[people/leo-chen]] on Oct 2
- [ ] HN post + blog post (Maya) — draft by Oct 3
- [ ] Benchmarks vs. two competitors on Northwind GPUs (Daniel)
- [ ] Go/no-go Wed Sep 30, 11am

## Numbers to watch
- Weekly active debuggers: 1,840 (beta). Goal after launch: 5,000 in 30 days.
- GitHub stars: 3.1k.

Shared checklist doc: https://docs.lumenlabs.dev/beam-launch-checklist
